::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">Jul 2026</div>
<div class="news-body">
Started as a **Postdoctoral Researcher** at LISSI, Université Paris-Est
Créteil — gait mode recognition, adaptive FES control, and portable clinical
devices for Parkinson's disease assessment.
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">Sep 2025</div>
<div class="news-body">
Joined **KAIST** (Daejeon, South Korea) as a postdoctoral researcher with
Dr. Jaegul Choo, working on physics-informed AI for human motion intention
inference (through March 2026).
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">Jul 2025</div>
<div class="news-body">
New paper in ***IEEE Transactions on Robotics***: "Real-Time LSTM-Driven
Dynamic Gait Mode Detection for Enhanced Control of Actuated Ankle-Foot
Orthosis."
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">2025</div>
<div class="news-body">
Gave an invited talk at the **REHAssist Visiting Seminar, EPFL**
(Switzerland), and volunteered at the **IFAC World Congress**.
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">May 2024</div>
<div class="news-body">
Co-authored paper on funnel-based L1 adaptive fuzzy control of an actuated
ankle-foot orthosis presented at **ICRA 2024**.
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">Jan 2024</div>
<div class="news-body">
Defended my **Ph.D.** at Université Paris-Est Créteil: *Human-in-the-loop
Paradigms for Mobility Assistance Using Powered Exoskeleton* (advisor:
Dr. Samer Mohammed).
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">May 2023</div>
<div class="news-body">
Our *RA-L* paper on hybrid half-Gaussian adaptive fuzzy control was presented
at **ICRA 2023** as an **oral session**.
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">Feb 2023</div>
<div class="news-body">
New paper in ***Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence***: fuzzy
convolutional attention-based GRU network for human activity recognition.
</div>
:::

::: {.news-item}
<div class="news-date">2022</div>
<div class="news-body">
Three journal papers published — ***IEEE T-RO*** (impedance modulation for
sit-to-stand), ***RA-L*** (adaptive fuzzy control of an ankle-foot orthosis),

</div>
